newsitem.title: UK: IPI seeks probe into Argentine newsman's killing.
newsitem.headline: IPI seeks probe into Argentine newsman's killing.

text.p: The International Press Institute on Tuesday condemned the killing of Argentine news photographer Jose Luis Cabezas and urged President Carlos Menem to order a full investigation into his death.

In a letter to Menem, the global organisation of editors and executives from newspapers and broadcasting and news agencies said those responsible for the weekend death of the 35-year-old photographer from Argentina's top-selling weekly news magazine Noticias must be brought to justice.

"IPI shares the concerns of many journalists in Argentina that Mr. Cabezas' murder could be related to his work, and merits an especially thorough investigation in a country where scores of journalists were murdered during the military regime of 1976-83 and where journalistic independence is being increasingly curtailed by a combination of violence and intimidation directed at journalists and media outlets," the group said.

Police found Cabezas' body in his charred car in a ditch outside the beach resort of Pinamar, southeast of Buenos Aires. He had been handcuffed, shot in the head and his body doused with fuel and set on fire.
Noticias has been critical of the Menem government but Cabezas' boss said the photographer had not been working on anything controversial.
